newsitem.title: USA: Roberts Oil says Adair Oil holds majority stake.
newsitem.headline: Roberts Oil says Adair Oil holds majority stake.

text.p: Roberts Oil and Gas Inc said Tuesday it had acquired a five percent net profit interest in certain exploration acreage from Adair Oil & Gas International in exchange for Roberts common stock.
As a result, Adair, a private company, now owns a majority stake in Roberts.
The Roberts board of directors has resigned and has been replaced by a new board headed by John Adair as chairman and chief executive officer, Roberts said.
The new board has retained Earl Roberts as president and chief operating officer.
The exploration acreage totals 14 million acres in South America and 3.5 million acres in the Middle East with estimated reserves in excess of three billion barrels of oil.
Roberts will retain its headquarters in Houston and change its name to Adair Oil and Gas International.
Roberts currently has an interest in 140 domestic wells.
